subscribe.title: Subscribe
subscribe.lede: Subscribe for a new annual set of twelve copies, or renew your existing subscription.
subscribe.step1: Pay using any one method in the table.
subscribe.step2: Open WhatsApp with the button below (a draft message is ready).
subscribe.step3: Attach your payment screenshot and fill in name, address, and phone.
subscribe.qrCaption: Preferred: scan this QR with Google Pay, PhonePe, or any UPI app.
subscribe.qrAlt: UPI QR code for Sathya Sai Balavikas subscription payment
subscribe.payRequired: Choose one payment method only — UPI, NEFT, demand draft, cheque, or money order.
subscribe.afterPay: Message Smt. U. Madhuri on WhatsApp with your payment proof and postal details.
